mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, the skies are clear and the temperature is 47 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, under a Full Moon.

Construction on Hwy M near the future Aldi site will cause a closure from October 5 to October 7 for road improvements. Also, please be aware of fraudulent emails requesting online payments for city planning fees; the City only accepts checks hand-delivered or mailed to City Hall.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee today, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and several trivia nights and the downtown farmers market occurring Tuesday, September 30.
In noteworthy news from September 5, the Verona Police Department investigated a series of reports involving cheese left on windshields, which they identified as a viral social media prank.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle. The Culver's of Verona will open today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
